ranked_facts.why: The presence of unilateral purulent nasal discharge mixed with blood is more characteristic of a nasal foreign body, which would cause a localized infection, than of other candidates such as infectious processes of the nasal cavity, inflammatory processes, or neoplastic processes, which might present with more bilateral or systemic symptoms.

The unilaterality of symptoms, such as the unilateral purulent discharge, points more towards an anatomical obstruction like a foreign body, which typically affects one side of the nasal cavity, rather than conditions that are more likely to cause bilateral symptoms.
